title: Inspired by hits
lyrics:
Updated Version – New Track
Got it. I removed the “Corey” line completely, leaned harder into your “social media text is so last week” idea, and changed the speaker line to “sing it to me, make those speakers peak” as you wanted.
Here’s the revised structure with your original words and energy, just updated per your directions:
Revised Lyrics (Ready for Suno)
lyrics[Intro]
Why our sound is loud
we sing it proud

[Verse 1]
text chat is done
was a fun run
comments denoted
text got fried
got spun out
right out
twisted text
twisting complete

[Hook]
ah dah,
social media text
that was so last week
what you got?
sing it to me

[Chorus]
ah like that
like that
you sang back
i got your track
singing it back
you sang to me
no twisted text
on my screen
just my pumping
your beat
from your chest
to my content
sing it to me
make those speakers peak
ah dah
this is so this week
we get to speak
make the bass tones
rattle the bones

[Verse 2]
but with no twisted text sister
we gonna sing with no resistor
time to escape
to a new place
sand box text lost
social media rocked
with a song pal
that sings back to me

[Final Hook / Outro]
what you got?
